description.value: Two Armies and One Omen: Objective: stop a premature crossing. Hold the ford or escort envoys; delay provokes the river bull.
The Island's Missing Voice: Objective: identify the lost companion. Compare echoes or recover the cook's bowl; delay lets the false navigator steer.
The Queue at Death's Border: Objective: hear the unfinished request. Join the humble line or ask the chorus; delay lets the royal shade erase it.
Under the Scraped Decree: Objective: recover the prophecy's condition. Read the tablet or find its rubbing; delay authorizes invasion.
A Storm Kept in Chains: Objective: plan a safe release. Mark the dive route or evacuate the hearths; delay wrecks another ship.
What a Life Left Undone: Objective: judge the deed fairly. Present the village record or remove the ranking mask; delay favors tomb wealth.
Standards in the Laurel Pass: Objective: secure a shared truce. Lower both banners or witness the envoys' pact; delay begins a duel.
Descent to the Pearl Altar: Objective: return the squall to open water. Use the anchor stone or a decoy shell; delay exhausts the diver's reed.
The Garden of Days: Objective: choose a voluntary farewell. Offer a memory or leave with the written request; delay draws the memory moth.
Weapons into Rescue Hooks: Objective: fulfill the rescue omen. Free stranded people or reopen the nonmilitary crossing; delay raises the flood.
The Companion Left Behind: Objective: acknowledge abandonment. Record the captain's admission or sing the missing verse; delay quenches the beacon.
An Errand for the Living: Objective: finish the requested task. Carry the message or witness a mourner's completion; delay closes the quiet ferry.
The River's Reckoning: Objective: decide the ford's future. Share repair labor or maintain a witnessed neutral passage; delay renews the muster.
The Homeward Flame: Objective: open a truthful route home. Name every companion or carry their chosen story; delay leaves the crew adrift.

name.value: A Return that is Not a Command

description.value: A Return that is Not a Command: Objective: honor the dead person's choice. Accept the farewell or fulfill the living request; delay grants the royal shade another claim.
A Prophecy Worth Keeping: Objective: settle the cities' legacy. Record the rescue and truce or renounce victory claims; name the next watch.
Weather without a Master: Objective: leave the island safely. Free the squall or bind only a voluntary shelter pact; name who repairs the anchorage.
The Road Back to Life: Objective: leave death's border with consent. Present the completed deed or witness an honest refusal; record the farewell.
River Reversal: both armies read the omen as permission to invade.
Missing Voice: the island echoes a command in the abandoned sailor's tone.
Unfinished Queue: the royal shade demands priority over a village mourner.
Tablet Scrape: a child spots marks beneath the public war decree.
Chain Strain: the captive storm pulls an anchored ship toward the rocks.
Day Offer: the garden asks for a freely given memory before a farewell.
Truce Arrival: Laurel envoys wait while both banks raise their standards.
Diver's Warning: the altar cannot receive the squall before hearths evacuate.
Humble Testimony: a village promise challenges the judge's gift-based ranking.
Foundry Petition: smiths offer rescue hooks instead of another weapon levy.
Forgotten Bowl: the cook asks why one companion is absent from every toast.
Ferry Question: the ferryman asks what task brought the living visitor below.
Bull at the Ford: raised banners draw the river guardian into the crowd.
Calm Bargain: the jar usurer offers a route home at the price of permanent captivity.
Memory Loss: a visitor's taken day vanishes before consent is recorded.
Watch Exchange: two soldiers consider lowering standards together.
Pearl Descent: the diver reaches the altar as the chained squall wakes.
Mask Removed: the chorus exposes how tomb wealth distorts the judgment.
Rescue Omen: the hidden tablet names stranded people rather than a conquered city.
Crew Confession: the captain admits the homeward route began with abandonment.
Sibling Request: Daro asks for a message and declines return to mortal life.
Flood Rise: water reaches the smiths' new rescue equipment.
Island Evacuation: the hearths accept a temporary move before storm release.
Errand Witness: a mourner can prove the requested deed is finished.
Shared Ford: both banks offer labor once the rescue is complete.
Beacon Song: the homeward story must include the lost sailor's final verse.
Borrowed Farewell: a visitor may spend a day or leave the garden without speaking.
Prophecy Fulfilled: the river returns after the chosen rescue and truce.
Unchained Weather: the crew leaves a free storm and a rebuilt anchorage.
Living Return: the ferry carries back the visitor with the completed request.
